These are minimal HTML table excerpts downloaded directly from the official RBI
website during the 8 October 2026 source audit. Each fixture retains its official
URL in an HTML comment, publication date, observation date, table cells and spans.
Navigation and unused economic rows are removed. No observation is synthesised.

Money-market fixtures cover a surplus day, a system-deficit Sunday, a June 2025
policy-change weekend, a no-trade December 2022 Sunday, an older pre-SDF day,
and the latest October 2026 policy-change observation. The pre-SDF fixture audits
historical parsing only; canonical persistence supports 8 April 2022 onwards.
Policy fixtures are the official April 2022, December 2025 and October 2026 MPC
decision excerpts. Tests altering units or malformed cells do so in memory only.

There is no WSS liquidity fallback: its operations-flow formula includes OMO and
is different from the MMO total outstanding liquidity concept plotted here.
